title: OL 9 system accounts must not have an interactive login shell.
source_xml:
<ns0:oval_definitions xmlns:ns0="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5" xmlns:ns1="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-common-5" xmlns:ns2="http://oval.mitre.org/XMLSchema/oval-definitions-5#unix"><ns0:generator>
        <ns1:product_name>Security Content Tool 1.9.0</ns1:product_name>
        <ns1:schema_version>5.11</ns1:schema_version>
        <ns1:timestamp>2026-06-25T09:42:07</ns1:timestamp>
      </ns0:generator>
      <ns0:definitions><ns0:definition id="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:def:258046" version="1" class="compliance">
          <ns0:metadata>
            <ns0:title>The operating system system accounts must not have an interactive login shell.</ns0:title>
            <ns0:description />
          </ns0:metadata>
          <ns0:criteria>
            <ns0:criterion test_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:tst:25804600" comment="The system accounts other than root have the login shell configured to /sbin/nologin." />
          </ns0:criteria>
        </ns0:definition>
        <ns0:definition id="oval:mil.disa.stig.ol9os:def:271845" version="1" class="compliance">
          <ns0:metadata>
            <ns0:title>OL09-00-003051 - OL 9 system accounts must not have an interactive login shell.</ns0:title>
            <ns0:affected family="unix">
              <ns0:platform>Oracle Linux 9</ns0:platform>
            </ns0:affected>
            <ns0:description>Ensuring shells are not given to system accounts upon login makes it more difficult for attackers to make use of system accounts.</ns0:description>
          </ns0:metadata>
          <ns0:criteria>
            <ns0:extend_definition definition_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.defs:def:258046" />
          </ns0:criteria>
        </ns0:definition>
        </ns0:definitions><ns0:tests><ns2:password_test id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:tst:25804600" version="2" check="all" comment="The system accounts in /etc/passwd use /sbin/nologin.">
          <ns2:object object_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:25804601" />
          <ns2:state state_ref="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804600" />
        </ns2:password_test>
        </ns0:tests><ns0:objects><ns2:password_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:25804600" version="1">
          <ns2:username operation="pattern match">.+</ns2:username>
        </ns2:password_object>
        <ns2:password_object id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:25804601" version="1" comment="only system accounts">
          <ns0:set set_operator="UNION">
            <ns0:object_reference>oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:obj:25804600</ns0:object_reference>
            <ns0:filter action="exclude">oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804601</ns0:filter>
            <ns0:filter action="exclude">oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804602</ns0:filter>
          </ns0:set>
        </ns2:password_object>
        </ns0:objects><ns0:states><ns2:password_state id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804600" version="2">
          <ns2:login_shell datatype="string" operation="pattern match">/sbin/nologin|/usr/sbin/nologin</ns2:login_shell>
        </ns2:password_state>
        <ns2:password_state id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804601" version="2">
          <ns2:user_id datatype="int" operation="greater than or equal">1000</ns2:user_id>
        </ns2:password_state>
        <ns2:password_state id="oval:mil.disa.stig.unix:ste:25804602" version="2">
          <ns2:user_id datatype="int" operation="equals">0</ns2:user_id>
        </ns2:password_state>
        </ns0:states></ns0:oval_definitions>
